Rules.title: Game rules
Rules.pronoWinnerBody: Lock in the right outcome (home win, draw, away win) before kickoff. The more unlikely the result, the more it pays. Maximum 220 Points per prediction to keep the game balanced.
Rules.pronoScoreBody: Go beyond the outcome and call the exact score. If you're on the right side AND few players found that exact score, you snag the Counter-Punch bonus: +10 Points (> 40%), +30 Points (Nice One), +60 Points (The Visionary), or +100 Points (💎 The Heist — under 5%!). The idea: surprise everyone.
Rules.pronoScorersBody: Name your scorers before kickoff. Each scorer found pays Points based on their rate — a defender who scores pays more than an expected striker. Maximum 150 Points per scorer, stackable.
Rules.liveWazeTitle: The Waze System — Flag an action
Rules.liveWazeBody: During the match, if you spot a hot moment (penalty, VAR offside, card…), tap the matching button. If enough players confirm in less than 30 seconds, a call opens for the whole community. On a quiet match, 1 signal is enough. On a big match, more are needed to filter out false alarms.
Rules.liveWindowBody: You have 90 seconds to commit your Sifflets on YES (the ref agrees) or NO (call reversed). After that, it's locked, we wait for the verdict.
Rules.liveParimutelBody: Rates aren't fixed: they shift in real time based on everyone's calls. More people on YES → the YES rate drops. It's a shared pot: Sifflets get redistributed among the winners. The (~Rate) shown is an estimate until the window closes.
Rules.liveGlobalPotBody: You're playing against the whole app, not just your mates. Sifflets from players who got it wrong fund the wins of those who saw it coming. Your private leagues are for the leaderboard and the banter — the pot itself is global.
Rules.liveKarmaBody: Every alert you trigger affects your trust score. True alert (YES): +2 pts. False alert (NO): −5 pts. If your score drops too low, the system silently ignores your alerts — without telling you.
Rules.championshipAdversaryBody: In 1vs1 mode, the league creator launches a full schedule (home + away). Each week, you face a different member. The schedule is locked from launch.
Rules.championshipScoreTitle: Predictions + VAR Calls = your weekly score
Rules.championshipScoreBody: Your weekly score combines two sources: your prediction Points (exact score, scorers) AND your net winnings on live VAR calls. Everything you win during the week counts — pre-match consistency AND live instinct.
Rules.championshipVictoryBody: At the end of the week, whoever has the most Points wins the match. Win = 3 Points in the standings, Draw = 1 Point each, Loss = 0. If the overall standings are tied, total Points break the tie (like goal difference).
Rules.championshipClosedBody: Once the championship launches, the league is sealed. Member count must be even (2 to 18) to balance the schedule.
Rules.seasonNewStartBody: On the 1st of every month, the season standings are frozen and archived. Your Sifflets carry over at 10% into the new season — to give everyone a real shot, no matter when you join.
Rules.seasonHallOfFameBody: Your total cumulative Points (across all seasons) are never wiped. They feed your Hall of Fame — a permanent record of your performances.
Rules.seasonRanksBody: At the end of each season: Champion (1st), Top 3, Top 10, Participant. These ranks are archived in your profile forever.

Laws.title: Laws of VAR
Laws.subtitle: The 4 official situations where video review can step in.
Laws.source: Source: IFAB Laws of the Game 2024/25 — FIFA VAR Protocol
Laws.sit01Body: VAR steps in to check whether a goal should be awarded or denied. This includes fouls in the buildup, offside positions, and intentional or unintentional handballs in the attacking phase.
Laws.sit02Body: Any decision to award or deny a penalty inside the box can be reviewed. VAR also checks whether players respected the box boundaries at the moment of the kick.
Laws.sit03Subtitle: Serious foul play or violent conduct
Laws.sit03Body: Direct red cards (not second yellows) can be reviewed: dangerous tackles, brutality, spitting, biting. A yellow given by mistake may be upgraded, but VAR does not review double cautions.
Laws.sit04Body: If the referee penalizes the wrong player — card or send-off — VAR corrects the identity. This case is rare but is covered by the official IFAB protocol since 2018.
Laws.principle01Body: VAR only steps in for clear errors. A referee can't be overruled on subjective judgments.
Laws.principle02Body: VAR recommends, the referee decides. They can go check the pitchside screen (OFR — On Field Review) to decide for themselves.
Laws.principle03Body: By protocol, players must wait for VAR validation before celebrating a goal. The referee raises their hand to signal the check.

Landing.faq01A: VAR TIME is a real-time prediction game about football. When a referee call is contested (penalty, VAR offside, card), the community anticipates and commits Sifflets — our virtual in-game currency.
Landing.faq02A: You can play entirely for free and earn your Sifflets just by playing. Eventually, you'll also be able to buy Sifflet packs if you want to go faster — that's optional, and you'll never lose any money you didn't choose to spend.
Landing.faq03A: Yes. VAR TIME is a PWA (Progressive Web App). From Safari, tap Share then "Add to Home Screen" to install it in 3 seconds. No App Store required.
Landing.faq04A: No. Predictions are made only with Sifflets, the virtual in-game currency. No winnings convert into real money — you can win or lose Sifflets, never money. If you choose to buy Sifflet packs, you know exactly what you're spending, and that's it.
Landing.faq05A: Yes. VAR TIME is a simulation game with internal virtual currency. No winnings convert into real money. It does not constitute a real-money betting service under French law and is not regulated by the ANJ.
Landing.faq06Q: How do I invite my mates?
Landing.faq06A: Create a private league from the Leagues tab, copy the link, and share it. Your mates join in one click.
